content: अभियुज् €7 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To apply oneself to, exert oneself, make oneself ready for, prepare, set about, strive or endeavour (used in {%passive%} also in this sense); तद्यदि न सहते ततः स्वयमभियुज्यस्व . एते स्वकर्मण्यभियुज्यामहे . <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; <ls>Dk. 55</ls>; <ls>K. 300</ls>; व्यसनमभियुञ्जानस्य <ls>Mu. 4</ls> trying to find out a weak point. .²2 To attack, assail; भवन्तमभियोक्तुमुद्युङ्क्ते <ls>Dk. 3</ls>; वृषलमभियोक्तुमुद्यतः <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; क इदानीमभियोक्ष्यते <ls>U. 3</ls>. .²3 To accuse, charge; complain or inform against, prosecute, claim or demand (as in a law-suit); न तत्र विद्यते किंचिद्यत्परैरवियुज्यते <ls>Ms. 8. 183</ls>; विभावितैकदेशेन देयं यदभियुज्यते <ls>V. 4. 17</ls> claimed, asked, or demanded; <ls>Y. 2. 9</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">28</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">100</ls>. .²4 To wish or long for, desire, ask for, request. .²5 To say, speak, tell; नाभियोक्तुमनृतं त्वमिष्यसे <ls>Ki. 13. 58</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">14. 7</ls>. .²6 To appoint to, entrust with (with <ab>loc.</ab>). .²7 To use with (<ab>instr.</ab>). .²8 To be working or operative. .²9 To put to; harness; harness repeatedly. .²10 To hurt. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To join or unite to, attach oneself to; परकलत्रेषु सुहृत्त्वेनाभियोज्य <ls>Dk. 163</ls>.
